jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: Senior backend and AI engineering role developing reliable internal AI tools and production services. Build backend APIs and integrations, reusable AI capabilities, MCP connectors, agent workflows and orchestration, secure deployment pathways, governance, observability and documentation. Requirements include production experience in Go, Python or comparable languages, AI or LLM applications, engineering judgment, security awareness and collaboration with business stakeholders. The company reports operating since 2017 and serving 23 European markets.

Build MCP connectors, agent workflows and secure deployment patterns

Production AI or LLM application experience
